SPINR RIDER v6 — iOS App Store · 1290 × 2796

Frames 1–2 are a connected pair (reference-style layout, Spinr colors):
the tilted phone leaves frame 1's right edge and continues on frame 2,
so side-by-side in the store they read as one composition. Proudly
Canadian lives on frame 1's badge block.

FRAME 3 — faithful to ride-options.tsx: the real production
illustrations (fetched from the vehicle-illustrations bucket), the
selected row's image at full size vs 0.59 for unselected (the app's
exact transform), charcoal selected border + checkmark, and per-row
slashed prices in the app's green (#10B981) under a WELCOME15 promo.
Economy lands at $7.99. Promo code and prices are sample data.

SAMPLE DATA — swap before submitting: fares/discounts, WELCOME15,
addresses, "Sam R.", plate 4WX 812, ratings, ETAs, driver counts.
Tier names/capacities and FAQ questions are real production values.
